title: Man Gets Caught Smuggling 16 Migrants During Police Boat Chase
description:
On June 17, 2021, a Broward County Sheriff's deputy attempted to stop a vessel full of illegal immigrants in Pompano Beach, FL. They eventually crashed into a seawall where 16 individuals fled from the vessel onto land. Of the 16 occupants, there were 3 previously removed for aggravated felony convictions including murder.

More info:
https://www.justice.gov/usao-sdfl/pr/man-sentenced-five-years-prison-smuggling-previously-deported-convicted-murderer

For business inquiries or other questions contact:
codebluecam@gmail.com

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
